qualifies_reason: Self-described independent Milan publisher with Issue 09 (2026) on sale in its own shop and Issue 08 released in late 2025.
what_it_is: Carnale is a Milan biannual where fashion photography meets erotica: each 300-page issue gathers around sixteen photographic stories, artist contributions, interviews and essays on a theme, with four alternative covers. Issue 09, 'Backwards', is about slowing down and reclaiming time, body and desire. It is for readers of adult-oriented fashion and image culture and collectors of large-format Italian independents.
